newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: INSTANT VIEW-New DRB-Hicom chief named.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-New DRB-Hicom chief named.

text.p: Following is a sample of views on the appointment of Saleh Sulong as the new head of the DRB-Hicom group of companies which manufactures the country's national Proton car.
The former chairman of Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional (Proton) was killed in a helicopter crash on Monday night.
OOI SOON BENG, HEAD OF RESEARCH, INTER-PACIFIC SECURITIES

"Most of us expected Saleh Sulong to becom chairman. They (DRB-Hicom) don't want to rock the boat. The priority is to ensure continuity. The group is too big for its future to depend on one person. It is fundamentally driven. I would think Sulong is a permanent appointment."
